svg.title: Mini-batch training of GraphSAGE on ogbn-arxiv: full batch, NeighborLoader, ClusterLoader and GraphSAINT
svg.desc: A 3-layer GraphSAGE is trained on ogbn-arxiv (169,343 nodes, 2.3 million undirected edges, 40 classes) with Adam and cross-entropy, and evaluated on the full graph or with layer-wise inference. One training batch is shown for four strategies on the same toy graph: full batch uses every node and edge in one step; NeighborLoader samples 15, 10 and 5 neighbors per hop around 1,024 seed nodes and computes the loss on the seeds only; ClusterLoader merges 25 of 500 precomputed clusters and drops the edges to the other clusters; GraphSAINTRandomWalkSampler takes the subgraph induced by short random walks and weights the loss with node_norm. Full-batch training is compared with PyG on the CPU. ShaDowKHopSampler, RandomNodeLoader, ImbalancedSampler and DynamicBatchSampler are also covered.
